about: Session 1422 (chain 111): real rows of two tables of the live set, read once with the anon key at read_at, for the render cases of the Mix tab's older blocks (scripts/grid-render-standin.mjs): eia930_generation_latest, every row of ERCOT's, ISO-NE's and the Lower 48's (eia930:ERCO, eia930:ISNE, eia930:US48; MW, hourly, hour starts in UTC), for "today so far"; and state_generation_mix_monthly, every row of the United States (eia:US; MWh, monthly, the month's first day), for "monthly mix since 2001". Each key is entity|variable, each row [ts_utc, value]. CAISO's generation is not drawn (session 118), so none of it is held here.
